title: Fire pit — sitting alone with a mug
userInput: Becky sitting on a log by the fire pit at night with a mug
expected: A photorealistic photograph of one adult woman sitting on a log bench beside a stone-ringed communal fire pit at night, a chipped enamel mug held in both hands, leaning slightly forward into the warmth. Orange firelight moves up from below across her face and knees while the grass and tree line behind her fall away into black. A cooler and a couple of cans sit on the log beside her, sparks rise above the flames. Full body shot at eye level across the fire, 35mm, natural skin texture, sharp focus.
